# Local reference benchmark

`reference_cpu.json` and `.csv` were generated by the Release build with 20 iterations in the audited Linux sandbox using Zig 0.14.1 / Clang 19.1.7 on an Intel Xeon @ 2.90 GHz. They benchmark deterministic reference operations only and are not neural-model, mobile, quality, memory, or thermal claims. Re-run with `scripts/run_benchmarks.sh`; do not compare across different build/hardware metadata.
